claims.statement: AdapterRegistry (src/agent-host/channels/adapter-registry.ts) registers three ChannelAdapter implementations for weixin, telegram, and feishu/lark channels.
ChannelAccountConfig (src/shared/channel-types.ts) records channel id, DM/group policies, allowlists, requireMention, opt-in slash commands, default work cwd, and the per-account tool set.

Channel secrets are never stored in config; ChannelManager's secretAccess calls the main process channelSecrets.get/set/delete, which persist them in the OS-backed CredentialVault keyed channel:<channel>:<accountId>.

evaluateInboundPolicy (src/agent-host/channels/policy.ts) allows open DMs and allowlisted senders, pairs unknown senders under the pairing policy, and ignores others; group messages additionally require the group policy, requireMention, and allowlist matches.
Inbound messages are processed serially per route key through LaneScheduler, which runs up to maxConcurrent (default 4) unrelated lanes in parallel while preserving per-conversation ordering.
Pairing approvals (PAIRING_TTL_MS=10min) add the peer id to allowFrom when approved; rejected or expired pairings are dropped.

PiSessionBridge (src/agent-host/channels/pi-session-bridge.ts) opens or resumes an agent session in a binding's cwd, passing the account toolNames, and drives runs through the existing RPC session machinery.
Outbound file sends via the channel bridge require an explicit user request and enforce size/count limits (20 MiB, four files) plus outside-workspace and symlink guards.
Account, binding, state and media stores use atomic temp-file + rename writes with 0o600 modes; channel status and activity are checkpointed and pushed to the renderer.
connectAccount verifies the credential already exists in the OS vault and validates it with a provider probe before activating the account.
